// diagnostic

E0111

This name was made with `:`, so it can't change

What

This name was made with `:`, so it can't change

Why

Only `:=` bindings (and `&` parameters) can be changed

Fix

Declare the name with `:=` instead of `:`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0111: tests/ui/E0111_loop_variable_is_fixed_per_pass.stderr.

Error [jet.ImmutableAssignment]: `i` is a loop variable, so it can't change
  --> tests/ui/E0111_loop_variable_is_fixed_per_pass.jet:5:9
    |
  5 |         i = i + 1
    |         ^
 Why: A loop variable holds the item of the current pass, and each pass binds it afresh
 Fix: Make a changeable copy inside the loop body: `n := i`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0111
